name: Tyrannic Exchange (Combat)
body:
Tooth for a tooth. A blow for a blow.

Prerequisite(s): Str or Dex 15, August Tyrant Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +3

Benefit(s): When a creature you threaten successfully attacks you while you are using this style, you may make an attack against that creature as an immediate action after the triggering attack is resolved.

Special: This feat’s benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
